basic_info.description: Offered for sale is 719 Myra Way, a charming 2 bedroom/1 bath home, with expansion potential, located in desirable Miraloma Park. Entry leads to a light-filled living room, eat-in kitchen with access to a large deck, 2 bedrooms, one with deck access and a full bath with skylight. Spacious patio and backyard. 1 car garage with storage areas and expansion potential. Refinished floors, new paint, landscaped yard. Minutes from shopping, transportation, including freeways 101 and 280, MUNI, and Glen Park BART. This home is an excellent condo alternative.
